_how: Manual rating adjustments for the NFL Super Bowl simulation. Add a row per team: key = team code (KC) or full name, pts = points added to the team's rating (negative = worse, limit 10), until = last day it applies (YYYY-MM-DD), note = why. Example: "KC": {"pts": -4.5, "until": "2026-12-15", "note": "QB out"}. Your judgment, not backtested; the NFL tab shows a notice while a row is active.
